title: Sales at or above target
objective: Use SUMIF with comparison criteria, a target stored in a cell and a separate sum range.
instructions: The line list is in A1:D11 and the target (K) is in H2. In F2, total the Sales (K) of lines at or above the target, using ">="&H2. In F3, total the Sales (K) of lines below 60. In F4, add up the Pairs sold (column D) on the lines whose Sales are at or above the target. In F5, divide F2 by the total of all sales (use SUM) to get the share as a decimal (for example 0.5, not 50%). Use $ signs on the ranges.

starter.E2: Sales on lines at or above target (K)
starter.E4: Pairs sold on lines at or above target
starter.E5: Share of sales from lines at or above target

hints: With no third argument, SUMIF adds the cells it tests: =SUMIF($C$2:$C$11, criteria).
For F2 the criteria is ">="&$H$2. For F3 it is "<60". For F4 test column C but add column D: =SUMIF($C$2:$C$11,">="&$H$2,$D$2:$D$11).
For F5, divide the F2 result by the whole sales column: =F2/SUM($C$2:$C$11).
